description_en: Queries a list of permissions for a database role
kebab_example: aliyun polardb describe-encryption-db-role-privilege --db-cluster-id pc-wz9fb5nn44u1d0000 --role-privilege-name-list test --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeEncryptionDBRolePrivilege

parameters.help_en:
The name of the role permission to query. To query multiple permissions at a time, enter multiple permission names and separate them with commas (,).

> - Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html operation to view the details of all role access policy rules for the cluster. The details include the permission names
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的角色权限名称。支持输入多个规则名称进行批量查询，多个名称间用英文逗号（,）分隔。
> * 您可以通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/212573.html查看目标集群下的所有角色策略规则详情，包括规则名称
parameters.name: role_privilege_name_list
